summary: AstraZeneca filed a Form 6-K confirming completion of a $2 billion equity investment in Summit Therapeutics, announced 5 October 2026, granting AstraZeneca a strategic minority stake rather than control. The investment funds development of ivonescimab, a PD-1/VEGF bispecific, combined with antibody-drug conjugates; separate clinical collaborations cover sonesitatug vedotin and Daiichi Sankyo's Datroway. No per-share price, ownership percentage, premium, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed, and financial terms reference a September 2026 agreement. Watch for the ownership split and governance rights, and whether the stake presages a broader bid for Summit.
